record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, reduce only the tied real-item embedding normalization multiplier from 0.75 to 0.70, preserving the vocabulary-dependent radius formula and raw learned exclusive mask vector. The regression at 0.80 motivates testing weaker item magnitude relative to positional inputs. Preserve features, dimensions, backbone, history, scoring, loss and optimizer; use the same normalization in training and prediction, with one model per category.
